Our Wedding Taxi

One Beautiful Taxi,
Dressed for Your Day

Our white wedding taxi is chosen for one reason: it looks wonderful in photographs and feels special from the moment it arrives. Its classic shape and bright white finish pair beautifully with ribbons and flowers in your colours, and it sits just as comfortably outside a grand hotel as it does at a Glasgow registry office.

On the day, the taxi is prepared carefully before it leaves — polished, dressed and ready early — so the only thing you need to think about is enjoying the journey.

  • Immaculately presented — cleaned and detailed before every wedding, inside and out.
  • Dressed to match your day — ribbons and finishing touches in keeping with your wedding style.
  • A calm, comfortable journey — an unhurried ride with time for photographs along the way.
  • Made for wedding photographs — a timeless backdrop for some of the day's favourite pictures.

How It Works

Booking Is Simple

01

Choose Your Date

Wedding dates — especially Saturdays — are booked well ahead, so check your date as early as you can.

02

Send Your Details

Tell us your pickup point, venue and timings using the enquiry form below — it takes just a couple of minutes.

03

Confirm the Arrangements

We'll reply to confirm availability and agree the details of your journey, so everything is settled in advance.

04

Enjoy Your Special Day

The taxi arrives early, dressed and ready. All that's left is to relax and enjoy the ride.

About Us

A Glasgow Wedding Taxi, with a Personal Touch

White Wedding Taxi Glasgow is a wedding transport service based in Glasgow, built around a single, beautifully kept white taxi and a simple promise: your journey to the ceremony should feel like part of the celebration, not just a way of getting there.

Because we focus on one taxi and one wedding at a time, every booking gets our full attention — from the first message you send us to the moment we wave you into your reception.

Where we travel

We're based in Glasgow and regularly serve weddings across the city and the surrounding areas. Tell us your venue when you enquire and we'll confirm your journey.
